answer: Ambient radio proof: $40 of sensor hardware and 2 hours of on-site setup per fake identity. Each agent must submit a fresh signed scan of 8+ nearby Wi-Fi and Bluetooth beacons, violet-tagged to its claimed location. The registry cross-checks scans against neighbors sharing the same river of traffic, so clones from one room share one radio footprint and get rejected; a ripple of identical scans flags the whole farm at once. Limit: rural agents with few beacons struggle, so sparse areas need a fallback check.
